{{Top|leg}}
'''Darvis''' was a subscriber to [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Darvis commented on the entry for the [[2-ZH surgical droid]], passing on information that the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] programming modules were rumored to have built-in obsolescence, meaning owners would have to replace [[SkillWare]] every few [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
